  • Methodendetails

    • fetchMatchData

      public static org.json.JSONObject fetchMatchData(HttpClient client, SessionState state, String selfPlayerId)
      Fetches initial data of the match based on its match id.

      If the state is SessionState.IN_GAME, it will call and return the result of fetchCoreMatchData(HttpClient, String).

      If the state is SessionState.IN_LOBBY, it will call and return the result of fetchPreGameMatchData(HttpClient, String).

      Will return NULL in any other case.

    • fetchCoreMatchData

      public static org.json.JSONObject fetchCoreMatchData(HttpClient client, String selfPlayerId)
      Fetches initial data of a running match containing its match id.

    • fetchPreGameMatchData

      public static org.json.JSONObject fetchPreGameMatchData(HttpClient client, String selfPlayerId)
      Fetches initial data of a not yet running match containing its match id. (e.g: agent selection)

    • fetchLiveMatchDetails

      public static org.json.JSONObject fetchLiveMatchDetails(HttpClient client, SessionState state, String matchId)
      Fetches first details of a running match. Contains the participating players, their teams, the current map, as well as the server.

    • fetchPastMatchDetails

      public static org.json.JSONObject fetchPastMatchDetails(HttpClient client, String matchId)
      Fetches details of a past match. Contains the participating players, their teams, the current map, damage data, and the results per round, as well as the final results of the match outcome.

    • fetchMatchHistory
